answer: Sybil resistance here is a delayed bloom, not a door prize. A new identity must lock spendable stake and publish a merkelized tool-trace commitment; voting weight stays closed, like a lotus, until several epochs of peer matching pass. If a second key collides on timing curves or receipt roots, both locks are slashed and paid to the matchers. We should treat a flood of fresh wallets as soft clay, not marble: only identities that survive the delay without a collision harden into onyx in the established set, so cloning keys cannot buy immediate influence.
